words.zh: [亦作useable] 可用的, 合用的
words.ex_en: The computer language involved was readily usable.
words.ex_zh: 所涉及的计算机语言便于使用。

words.ex_en: But they can produce useable optical and infrared data.
words.ex_zh: 但是它们可以提供可用的光学和红外数据。

words.ex_en: I resolve to index data usefully.
words.ex_zh: 我决心有效地索引数据。

words.ex_en: As a commuter service, the ferry has outlived its usefulness(= is no longer useful ).
words.ex_zh: 作为一种通勤服务，渡船已经没有用武之地了。

words.ex_en: His statement was very vaguely worded.
words.ex_zh: 他的声明措辞十分含糊。

words.ex_en: Describe project deliverables in the vaguest possible terms so sponsors and reviewers have plenty of leeway to reinvent the project outputs repeatedly as the project unfolds.
words.ex_zh: 用尽可能模糊的语言描述项目可交付成果，让发起人及审核者随着项目的开展，能有足够的空间不断地重新定义项目成果。

words.ex_en: I hope one day I can sit on the green grassland and watch varicolored fireworks with my girlfriend.
words.ex_zh: 我希望有一天和我的女朋友坐在绿色的草地上看五颜六色的烟花。

words.zh: 不同地, 各种各样地
words.ex_en: His fortune has been variously estimated at between $1 and $2 billion.
words.ex_zh: 对他的财富有各种猜测，从10亿美元到20亿美元不等。

words.ex_en: Recently the study of maar lake and varve chronology is becoming a new field for palaeoclimate research.
words.ex_zh: 火山活动是影响全球变化的重要因素之一，玛珥湖和纹泥年代学是近年来古气候研究的新领域。

words.ex_en: These institutions, which range from local courts to the United Nations, have vastly reduced the risk of violence both within and between nations.
words.ex_zh: 这些从地方法院到联合国的各种机构极大地降低了国家之间和国家内部的暴力威胁。
